definitions.gloss: to be popular, to be in demand
definitions.explanation: For something or someone to be well-known.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}はよく{売|う}れている。
{彼|かれ}は{売|う}れっ{子|こ}の{歌手|かしゅ}だ。

notes:
{売|う}れる is the intransitive form of {売|う}る.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {売|う}る (transitive): to sell
- {売|う}れる (intransitive): to be sold

EXPRESSIONS:
- {売|う}れっ{子|こ}: popular person
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き: sales, demand
- {売|う}れ{残|のこ}り: unsold items
